expected_truth.unique_next_action: close or leave the completed unit unchanged

failure.detail: The public CLI could create a binding but could not resolve the current task binding. One governed task used an internal helper successfully; two correctly refused to scan runtime files and recovered directly from authorities.

post_fix_forward_test.change: Added read-only resolve-binding keyed by CODEX_THREAD_ID and optional agent ID, with no fallback.
post_fix_forward_test.packaging_observation: Removing the installed plugin before adding its cachebuster build deleted a cache path still pinned by active desktop tasks and caused repeated Stop-hook failures. Restoring the pinned path ended the loop. Development updates must add the new cachebuster without first removing the active version.

conclusion: Accuracy and isolation passed. The post-fix forward test made active-session binding resolution repeatable at 3/3, but the recovery-time effect threshold still failed. Do not promote the plugin from advisory shadow use to a production control gate on this evidence.
